name: Visabeira
verdict: Owned by Grupo Visabeira, S.A. — held 98.57% by its founder Fernando Campos Nunes through NCFGest, S.A. Nothing found.
note: Portuguese conglomerate (telecoms, energy, industry incl. Vista Alegre, tourism, construction), founded in Viseu in 1980. Main kit sponsor at Academico de Viseu in 2026-27. Rating note: Grupo Visabeira's Relatório & Contas 2025 and Martifer's market release of 6 August 2025 both name one individual, Fernando Campos Nunes, as its ultimate owner through NCFGest; no state or state fund in the chain. Nothing passes the METHOD.md test.
